runtime.name: Brainstem Agent
runtime.platform: macOS only (qualified on Apple silicon); needs /usr/bin/sandbox-exec

capabilities.title: Deploy
capabilities.summary: setup downloads and verifies the pinned core and builds a private environment; doctor --deep proves readiness.
limits: This Mac only; no cloud or remote deployment yet.

capabilities.title: Always available
capabilities.summary: serve --detach runs an always-on daemon with a warm worker; service install adds a login LaunchAgent.
limits: Work pauses while the Mac sleeps; no remote host yet.

capabilities.title: Schedule
capabilities.summary: Ask in plain language or use schedules: one-time, interval and cron, time zones and DST, missed-run and overlap rules, pause, resume, edit, run-now and remove, with results in an inbox.
limits: Runs only while the daemon is running.

capabilities.title: Connect
capabilities.summary: Messaging apps and email are not connected yet; today you use the terminal, and tools connect through MCP.

capabilities.title: Remember
capabilities.summary: Workspace and profile memory with correction and forgetting, search across past conversations, and AGENTS.md context files.
limits: Local to this Mac; retrieval is keyword ranking (BM25), not semantic embeddings.

capabilities.title: Isolate
capabilities.summary: Every core worker, shell command, script and local MCP server runs under the macOS sandbox (Seatbelt) with private per-worker files; tool processes cannot read your home folder or your sign-in and write only inside the workspace; the shell has no network.
limits: macOS sandbox only; not a VM or container.

capabilities.title: Learns skills
capabilities.summary: Saves how it solved a task as a versioned skill (unreviewed until you approve), offers it in later turns, and lets you review, approve, edit, disable and export it.
limits: Skills are data offered to the model, never executed and never granting permissions; review is manual.

capabilities.title: Long tasks
capabilities.summary: Continues automatically past the core's three-tool-round limit and streams progress; Ctrl-C cancels and stops the worker.
limits: Bounded per turn (segments, tool calls, time).

capabilities.title: Helpers
capabilities.summary: Runs up to three helper workers in parallel, each a fresh sandboxed core worker with narrower permissions.
limits: One level of helpers; bounded count.

capabilities.title: Tools and processes
capabilities.summary: Files, a sandboxed shell, sandboxed Python scripts that call tools, and background processes (start, poll, log, stop).
limits: Inside the workspace; the shell has no network.

capabilities.title: Web
capabilities.summary: Fetches pages and searches (Wikipedia by default) with citations; private and cloud-metadata addresses are refused; an owner egress policy and log; web content can never make it remember or forget.
limits: The search provider is Wikipedia unless configured.

capabilities.title: MCP
capabilities.summary: Connects MCP servers (stdio and streamable HTTP) from a JSON config; tools appear as mcp__server__tool; each local server gets its own sandbox profile and permission.
limits: You add and trust servers yourself.

capabilities.title: Receipts and recovery
capabilities.summary: Every tool call gets a receipt (succeeded, failed or uncertain); a repeated request with an idempotency key replays without a new model call; interrupted work is recovered or marked uncertain.
limits: Backup and restore, upgrade and rollback, and credential rotation are not there yet.

capabilities.title: Terminal session and web companion
capabilities.summary: An interactive terminal session and an owner-only local web companion are being built on the same engine.
limits: Not released; today you use the commands.

capabilities.title: Browser, images and voice
capabilities.summary: No browser automation, image understanding or generation, transcription or speech yet.
